```{r setup-and-data}
# Packages used by the analyses and figures below.
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
library(tibble)
library(purrr)
library(stringr)
library(ggplot2)
library(ggrepel)
library(decoupleR)
library(ggvenn)
library(clusterProfiler)
library(org.Hs.eg.db)
library(enrichplot)
library(ComplexHeatmap)
library(circlize)
library(grid)
library(svglite)
library(tidytext)

# Local helper functions used in this report.
source("function.R")

# Harmonize the four differential-expression result tables to a shared schema.
DMD <- readRDS(file = "data/DMD_paper.RDS")
DMD$dataset  <- DMD$dataset %>% 
  dplyr::rename(padj = adj.P.Val, log2FoldChange = logFC, Symbol = Gene.symbol)  %>% 
  arrange(padj) %>% 
  distinct(entrezgene_id, .keep_all = T) %>% 
  mutate(group = if_else(log2FoldChange < 0,"downregulated","upregulated"), disease = "DMD")  %>% 
  filter(!is.na(entrezgene_id))

EDMD <- readRDS(file = "data/EDMD_paper.RDS")
EDMD$dataset  <- EDMD$dataset %>% 
  arrange(padj) %>% 
  distinct(entrezgene_id, .keep_all = T) %>% 
  mutate(group = if_else(log2FoldChange < 0,"downregulated","upregulated"), disease = "EDMD") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(entrezgene_id)) 

DNM2 <- readRDS(file = "data/DNM2_paper.RDS")
DNM2$dataset  <- DNM2$dataset %>%
  arrange(padj) %>% 
  distinct(entrezgene_id, .keep_all = T)  %>% 
  dplyr::select(-entrezgene_id) %>% dplyr::rename(Symbol = Human_symbol, entrezgene_id = ENTREZID)  %>%
  mutate(group = if_else(log2FoldChange < 0,"downregulated","upregulated"), disease = "DNM2")  %>% 
  filter(!is.na(entrezgene_id))

POMPE <- readRDS(file = "data/Pompe_paper.RDS")
POMPE$dataset  <- POMPE$dataset %>% 
  dplyr::rename(padj = adj.P.Val, log2FoldChange = logFC, Symbol = hgnc_symbol) %>% 
  arrange(padj) %>% 
  distinct(entrezgene_id, .keep_all = T)  %>% 
  mutate(group = if_else(log2FoldChange < 0,"downregulated","upregulated"), disease = "POMPE") %>% 
  filter(!is.na(entrezgene_id))

datasets <- list(
  DMD = DMD,
  EDMD = EDMD,
  DNM2 = DNM2,
  POMPE = POMPE
)

# Ranked vectors are used for pathway visualisation at the end of the report.
combined_de_results <- datasets %>%
  map(~ .$dataset) %>% 
  map(~ ungroup(.)) %>% 
  map(~ dplyr::select(.,log2FoldChange, disease,entrezgene_id, padj)) %>%
  map(~ dplyr::mutate(.,entrezgene_id = as.character(entrezgene_id))) %>% 
  list_rbind() %>% mutate(entrezgene_id = as.character(entrezgene_id))

entrez_ids <- list(
  DMD = filter(combined_de_results, disease == "DMD") %>% pull(entrezgene_id),
  EDMD = filter(combined_de_results, disease == "EDMD") %>% pull(entrezgene_id),
  DNM2 = filter(combined_de_results, disease == "DNM2") %>% pull(entrezgene_id),
  POMPE = filter(combined_de_results, disease == "POMPE") %>% pull(entrezgene_id)
)

log2_fold_changes <- list(
  DMD = filter(combined_de_results, disease == "DMD") %>% pull(log2FoldChange),
  EDMD = filter(combined_de_results, disease == "EDMD") %>% pull(log2FoldChange),
  DNM2 = filter(combined_de_results, disease == "DNM2") %>% pull(log2FoldChange),
  POMPE = filter(combined_de_results, disease == "POMPE") %>% pull(log2FoldChange)
)

ranked_log2_fold_changes <- map2(log2_fold_changes, entrez_ids, setNames) %>%
  map(~ sort(.x, decreasing = TRUE))
```


# Differentially expressed genes {.tabset .tabset-fade}

```{r degs-per-disease}
degs <- extract_degs_no(list = datasets, 1.5)

deg_data <- data.frame(
  Disease = rep(c("DMD", "DNM2", "EDMD", "POMPE"), each = 2),
  Direction = rep(c("Up", "Down"), times = 4),
  DEGs = unlist(
    degs %>%
      map(~ c(
        Up   = sum(grepl("_upregulated$", .x)),
        Down = sum(grepl("_downregulated$", .x))
      )),
    use.names = FALSE
  )
)

# 🔧 Format factors
deg_data$Disease <- factor(deg_data$Disease, levels = c("DMD", "EDMD", "DNM2", "POMPE"))
deg_data$Direction <- factor(deg_data$Direction, levels = c("Up", "Down"))

# 🎨 Custom colors
color_map <- c("Up" = "#af8dc3", "Down" = "#7fbf7b")

# 📈 Plot
barplot_degs <- ggplot(deg_data, aes(x = Disease, y = DEGs, fill = Direction)) +
    geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "stack", width = 0.6) +
    geom_text(aes(label = DEGs), position = position_stack(vjust = 0.5), color = "white", size = 4.2, fontface = "bold") +
    scale_fill_manual(values = color_map) +
    labs(
        title = "",
        x = NULL,
        y = "Number of DEGs",
        fill = "Expression change"
    ) +
    theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
        plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5),
        axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold"),
        legend.position = "top"
    )

ggsave(
  filename = "figures/barplot_DEGs.svg",
  plot = barplot_degs,
  width = 5,
  height = 5,
  device = "svg"
)
```

# DEG heatmap
```{r deg-heatmap}
threshold <- 4 
genes <- unlist(degs)

common_genes <- names(which(table(unlist(lapply(degs, unique))) >= threshold)) %>%
  str_split("_", simplify = TRUE) %>%
  .[,1] %>%
  unique()

heatmap_df <- imap(datasets, ~{
  .x$dataset %>%
    dplyr::ungroup() %>%
    dplyr::select(Symbol, value = log2FoldChange) %>%
    dplyr::filter(Symbol %in% common_genes) %>%
    dplyr::distinct(Symbol, .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    dplyr::rename(!!.y := value)
}) %>%
  purrr::reduce(full_join, by = "Symbol")

mat <- heatmap_df %>%
  column_to_rownames("Symbol") %>%
  as.matrix()

# optional: fixed order
mat <- mat[, c("DMD", "EDMD", "DNM2", "POMPE"), drop = FALSE]

# replace NA if needed
mat[is.na(mat)] <- 0

# cap extreme values to avoid a few genes dominating the palette
cap <- 4
mat_plot <- mat
mat_plot[mat_plot > cap] <- cap
mat_plot[mat_plot < -cap] <- -cap

col_fun <- colorRamp2(
  c(-cap, 0, cap),
  c("blue", "white", "red")
)

ht <- Heatmap(
    mat_plot,
    name = "log2FC",
    col = col_fun,
    cluster_rows = TRUE,
    cluster_columns = FALSE,
    show_row_names = TRUE,
    show_column_names = TRUE,
    column_names_rot = 30,
    column_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 12, fontface = "bold"),
    row_names_gp = grid::gpar(fontsize = 9, fontface = "bold"),
  use_raster = FALSE
)
ht
```


# GSEA
```{r gsea}
analyse_KEGG <- readRDS("data/Analyse_KEGG_GSEA.RDS")  %>% 
  clusterProfiler::setReadable(OrgDb = "org.Hs.eg.db", keyType = "ENTREZID")


# keywords defining KEGG "Human Diseases"
disease_terms <- c(
  "Influenza", 
  "Pertussis", 
  "Rheumatoid", 
  "Myocarditis",
  "infection",
  "disease"
)

pathways <- analyse_KEGG %>% 
  as.data.frame() %>%
  filter(p.adjust < 0.05) %>%
  # ---- REMOVE DISEASE-LABELED KEGG TERMS ----
  filter(!stringr::str_detect(
    Description,
    stringr::regex(paste(disease_terms, collapse="|"), ignore_case = TRUE)
  )) %>%
  group_by(Description) %>% 
  summarise(
    n   = n(),
    NES = mean(NES),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>% 
  filter(n > 2)

pathways_up <- pathways %>% arrange(desc(n), desc(NES)) %>% head(15)
pathways_down <- pathways %>% arrange(desc(n), NES) %>% head(2)

analyse_KEGG_f <- analyse_KEGG %>%
  as.data.frame() %>%
  filter(Description %in% c(pathways_up$Description, pathways_down$Description)) %>%
  arrange(desc(NES))

analyse_KEGG_f <- as.data.frame(analyse_KEGG_f) %>%
  mutate(GeneRatio = setSize / max(setSize, na.rm = TRUE))

alpha <- 0.05

# 1) Keep only significant results (you can relax this if you want to show "presence/absence")
df0 <- analyse_KEGG_f %>%
  filter(!is.na(NES), !is.na(p.adjust)) %>%
  filter(p.adjust < alpha)

# 2) Remove mixed-direction pathways:
#    if a pathway has BOTH positive and negative NES across diseases -> drop it
keep_terms <- df0 %>%
  group_by(Description) %>%
  summarise(
    has_pos = any(NES > 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    has_neg = any(NES < 0, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter(!(has_pos & has_neg)) %>%          # <-- this enforces one direction only
  pull(Description)

df1 <- df0 %>% filter(Description %in% keep_terms)

# 3) Order pathways: a) thematic buckets, b) within-bucket by mean NES magnitude
bucketed <- df1 %>%
  group_by(Description) %>%
  summarise(
    NES_mean = mean(NES, na.rm = TRUE),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    bucket = case_when(
      str_detect(Description, regex("Lysosome|Phagosome|Antigen|Endocyt|Autophag|Proteasome", ignore_case=TRUE)) ~ "Endolysosomal / trafficking",
      str_detect(Description, regex("Cytokine|Complement|Hematopoietic|IgA|Staphylococcus|Viral|Influenza|Pertussis|Myocarditis", ignore_case=TRUE)) ~ "Immune / inflammation",
      str_detect(Description, regex("ECM|Adhesion|Focal adhesion|Cell adhesion", ignore_case=TRUE)) ~ "ECM / adhesion",
      str_detect(Description, regex("PI3K|p53|MAPK|TGF|WNT|Notch", ignore_case=TRUE)) ~ "Signaling / stress",
      str_detect(Description, regex("Citrate cycle|TCA|Oxocarboxylic|Oxidative|Glycolysis|Fatty acid|Peroxisome", ignore_case=TRUE)) ~ "Metabolism / mitochondria",
      TRUE ~ "Other"
    ),
    bucket = factor(bucket, levels = c(
      "Endolysosomal / trafficking",
      "Immune / inflammation",
      "ECM / adhesion",
      "Signaling / stress",
      "Metabolism / mitochondria",
      "Other"
    ))
  ) %>%
  arrange(bucket, desc(abs(NES_mean)))

ordered_levels <- bucketed$Description

df1 <- df1 %>%
  mutate(
    Description = factor(Description, levels = rev(ordered_levels)),
    Cluster = factor(Cluster, levels = c("DMD","EDMD","DNM2","POMPE"))  # adjust if needed
  )

K <- plot_gsea_dotplot(df1, color = "NES", showCategory = 10) +
  viridis::scale_fill_viridis(option="G", alpha=1, begin=1, end=.3, direction=-1) +
  xlab("") + scale_y_discrete(labels = ~ stringr::str_wrap(.x, width = 70))


```

# Transcription-factor activity

```{r load-raw-results-for-tf-analysis}
data_pompe <- readRDS("data/Pompe_paper.RDS")
data_EDMD <- readRDS("data/EDMD_paper.RDS")
data_DMD <- readRDS("data/DMD_paper.RDS")
data_DNM2 <- readRDS("data/DNM2_paper.RDS")
```


```{r transcription-factor-activity}

# Standardize DEG tables to gene, log2 fold-change, statistic, and adjusted p-value.
# Dataset-specific source columns are declared explicitly below.
standardize_deg <- function(df, gene_col, logfc_col,t, padj_col){
  df  %>%
    distinct(.data[[gene_col]], .keep_all = TRUE) %>%
    transmute(
      gene  = .data[[gene_col]],
      logFC = .data[[logfc_col]],
      t = .data[[t]],
      p_adj = .data[[padj_col]]
    ) %>% 
    filter(!is.na(gene), !is.na(logFC), !is.na(p_adj))
}

# ULM is run on all genes with a valid statistic, matching the final TF analysis
# in the original script. DEG thresholds are applied later only for TF-target plots.
deg_DMD <- standardize_deg(data_DMD$dataset, gene_col = "Gene.symbol", logfc_col = "logFC", t = "t", padj_col = "adj.P.Val")
deg_EDMD <- standardize_deg(data_EDMD$dataset, gene_col = "Symbol", logfc_col = "log2FoldChange", t = "stat", padj_col = "padj")
deg_Pompe <- standardize_deg(data_pompe$dataset, gene_col = "Gene.symbol", logfc_col = "logFC", t = "t", padj_col = "adj.P.Val")
deg_DNM2 <- standardize_deg(data_DNM2$dataset %>% ungroup, gene_col = "Human_symbol", logfc_col = "log2FoldChange", t = "stat", padj_col = "padj")



set.seed(123)

run_one_dataset <- function(deg, net){

  contrast_acts <- run_ulm(mat=deg[, 't', drop=FALSE], net=net, .source='source', .target='target', .mor='mor', minsize = 5) %>% 
    filter(p_value<0.05)
  return(contrast_acts)
}

net <- decoupleR::get_collectri(organism="human", split_complexes=FALSE)


res_DMD   <- run_one_dataset(deg_DMD %>% column_to_rownames(var="gene"),net) 
res_EDMD   <- run_one_dataset(deg_EDMD %>% column_to_rownames(var="gene"),net)
res_Pompe   <- run_one_dataset(deg_Pompe %>% column_to_rownames(var="gene"),net)
res_DNM2   <- run_one_dataset(deg_DNM2 %>% column_to_rownames(var="gene"),net)

acts_all <- bind_rows(
  res_DMD  %>% mutate(dataset = "DMD"),
  res_DNM2 %>% mutate(dataset = "DNM2"),
  res_EDMD %>% mutate(dataset = "EDMD"),
  res_Pompe %>% mutate(dataset = "Pompe")
)

acts_all <- acts_all %>%
  mutate(
    dataset = as.character(dataset),
    direction = ifelse(score > 0, "up", "down")
  )

# Display TFs that are consistently activated or inhibited in all four diseases.
tf_keep <- acts_all %>%
  group_by(source) %>%
  summarise(
    n_up = sum(score > 0),
    n_dn = sum(score < 0),
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  filter((n_up >= 4 & n_dn == 0) | (n_dn >= 4 & n_up == 0)) %>%
  pull(source)

acts_plot <- acts_all %>% filter(source %in% tf_keep)

p_top <- ggplot(acts_plot, aes(x = dataset, y = score, fill = dataset)) +
  geom_col(width = 0.85) +
  facet_grid(~ source, scales = "free") +
  labs(x = NULL, y = "TF activity") +
  theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
  theme(
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x.top = element_text(face = "bold"),
    axis.ticks.x = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_rect(fill = "grey95"),
    panel.grid.major.x = element_blank(),
    strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  )
```


# TF target and protein-interaction network

```{r tf-targets}
selected_tfs <- c("JUN", "AP1")

df <- net %>%
      dplyr::filter(source %in% selected_tfs) %>%
      dplyr::arrange(target) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(ID = target, color = "3")

degs_up <- extract_degs_no(list = datasets, 1.5)
all_genes <- unique(unlist(degs_up))

# Create a presence/absence matrix
gene_presence_df <- map_dfc(degs_up, ~ all_genes %in% .x) %>%
    mutate(Gene = all_genes) %>%
    relocate(Gene) %>% as.data.frame

gene_presence_df <- gene_presence_df %>%
  mutate(N = rowSums(dplyr::select(., -Gene)))

gene_presence_df <- gene_presence_df %>% filter(N >= 3)

test <- gene_presence_df$Gene %>% str_split("_", simplify=T) %>% .[,1]


deg_DMD_2 <- deg_DMD %>% as.data.frame %>% dplyr::filter(p_adj < 0.05, abs(logFC) > log2(1.5))
deg_DMD_2 <- deg_DMD_2 %>% column_to_rownames(var="gene")

deg_DMD_2 <- deg_DMD_2[rownames(deg_DMD_2) %in% test,]

inter <- sort(dplyr::intersect(rownames(deg_DMD_2), df$target))

df <- df %>% filter(target %in% inter)

 df <- deg_DMD_2 %>% rownames_to_column(var="genes") %>% left_join(df,., by=c("target"="genes"))

df <- df %>%
      dplyr::mutate(color = dplyr::if_else(mor > 0 & t > 0, '1', color)) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(color = dplyr::if_else(mor > 0 & t < 0, '2', color)) %>%
      dplyr::mutate(color = dplyr::if_else(mor < 0 & t > 0, '2', color)) %>%

colors <- rev(RColorBrewer::brewer.pal(n = 11, name = "RdBu")[c(2, 10)])

p <- ggplot2::ggplot(data = df, 
                     mapping = ggplot2::aes(x = logFC, 
                                            y = -log10(p_adj), 
                                            color = color,

                         color = "black") +

                                                      size = 1)) + 
     ggplot2::theme_bw() +

     ggplot2::geom_vline(xintercept = 0, linetype = 'dotted') +
```

```{r tf-string-network}
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(dplyr)
  library(tibble)
  library(STRINGdb)
  library(igraph)
  library(ggraph)
  library(ggplot2)
})

# Build a regulatory network for AP1 and JUN, augmented with STRING interactions.

tf_targets <- df %>% 
  dplyr::select(source,ID,mor) %>% 
  dplyr::mutate(mor = abs(mor)) %>% 
  dplyr::rename(tf = source,target = ID, weight = mor) %>% 
  dplyr::filter(target %in% degs_005_lfc15_3)

edges_tf <- tf_targets %>%
  transmute(
    from = tf,
    to = target,
    edge_type = "TF",
    weight = ifelse(is.na(weight), 1, weight),
    directed = TRUE
  )

deg_symbols <- unique(c(tf_targets$target[tf_targets$target %in% degs_005_lfc15_3], degs_005_lfc15_4, res_phago_filtered$fc_matrix_clust %>% rownames, res_lyso_filtered$fc_matrix_clust %>% rownames))   # si tu veux élargir
deg_symbols <- gsub("\\.[0-9]+$", "", deg_symbols)
deg_symbols <- deg_symbols[deg_symbols != "" & !is.na(deg_symbols)]

# STRING interaction edges between the selected DEGs.
# This step downloads STRING data if it is not already cached locally.
suppressPackageStartupMessages({
  library(STRINGdb)
  library(dplyr)
})

deg_symbols_clean <- unique(trimws(as.character(deg_symbols)))
deg_symbols_clean <- deg_symbols_clean[deg_symbols_clean != "" & !is.na(deg_symbols_clean)]

genes_df <- data.frame(gene = deg_symbols_clean, stringsAsFactors = FALSE)

string_cutoff <- 700
max_string_edges <- 700

string_db <- STRINGdb$new(version = "12.0", species = 9606, score_threshold = 0)

mapped_genes <- string_db$map(
  genes_df,
  "gene",
  removeUnmappedRows = TRUE,
  takeFirst = TRUE
)

ppi_raw <- string_db$get_interactions(mapped_genes$STRING_id)

ids <- mapped_genes$STRING_id
ppi_filt <- ppi_raw %>%
  dplyr::filter(from %in% ids, to %in% ids) %>%
  mutate(weight = combined_score) %>%
  dplyr::filter(weight >= string_cutoff)

id2gene <- setNames(mapped_genes$gene, mapped_genes$STRING_id)

edges_string <- ppi_filt %>%
  transmute(
    from = id2gene[from],
    to   = id2gene[to],
    edge_type = "STRING",
    weight = weight,
    directed = FALSE
  ) %>%
  filter(!is.na(from), !is.na(to), from != to) %>%
  rowwise() %>%
  mutate(pair = paste(sort(c(from,to)), collapse="__")) %>%
  ungroup() %>%
  group_by(pair) %>%
  summarise(across(c(from,to,edge_type,directed), first),
            weight = max(weight), .groups="drop") %>%
  dplyr::select(-pair) %>%
  arrange(desc(weight)) %>%
  slice_head(n = max_string_edges)

# Combine regulatory and STRING interaction edges.
edges_all <- bind_rows(edges_tf, edges_string)
nodes <- tibble(node = unique(c(edges_all$from, edges_all$to))) %>%
  mutate(
    node_type = case_when(
      node == "AP1" ~ "TF_AP1",
      node == "JUN" ~ "TF_JUN",
      node %in% tf_targets$target ~ "TF_target",
      TRUE ~ "DEG"
    )
  )

# Create graph
g <- graph_from_data_frame(edges_all, directed = TRUE, vertices = nodes)

# Define colors
node_cols <- c(
  TF_AP1 = "#E31A1C",    # rouge
  TF_JUN = "#6A3D9A",    # violet
  TF_target = "#FF7F0E", # orange
  DEG = "#1F77B4"        # bleu
)
edge_cols <- c(TF = "#111111", STRING = "#9E9E9E")

# Set node sizes
V(g)$size <- ifelse(V(g)$node_type %in% c("TF_AP1","TF_JUN"), 7,
                    ifelse(V(g)$node_type == "TF_target", 5, 3.5))

# Set edge widths
E(g)$ew <- ifelse(E(g)$edge_type == "TF",
                  1.4,
                  0.4 + 1.2 * (E(g)$weight / max(E(g)$weight, na.rm=TRUE)))


metrics <- tibble(
  gene = V(g)$name,
  degree = degree(g, mode = "all"),
  betweenness = betweenness(g)
) %>% filter(!gene %in% c("JUN","AP1"))

top_degree <- metrics %>%
  arrange(desc(degree)) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1:10) %>%
  mutate(metric = "Degree centrality",
         value = degree)

top_btw <- metrics %>%
  arrange(desc(betweenness)) %>%
  dplyr::slice(1:10) %>%
  mutate(metric = "Betweenness centrality",
         value = betweenness)

plot_data <- bind_rows(top_degree, top_btw)

plot_data <- plot_data %>%
    mutate(gene = reorder_within(gene, value, metric))

p <- ggplot(plot_data,
       aes(x = gene, y = value, fill = metric)) +
    geom_col(width = 0.7) +
    coord_flip() +
    facet_wrap(~metric, scales = "free") +
    scale_y_continuous(breaks = scales::pretty_breaks(n = 10)) +
    scale_x_reordered() +
    scale_fill_manual(values = c(
        "Degree centrality" = "#5A67D8",
        "Betweenness centrality" = "#38A169"
    )) +
    labs(
        x = NULL,
        y = NULL
    ) +
    theme_bw(base_size = 14) +
    theme(
        legend.position = "none",
        axis.text.y = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black"),
        axis.text.x = element_text(face = "bold", color = "black"),
        strip.text = element_text(face = "bold"),
        panel.grid.major.y = element_blank()
    )

# Compute a deterministic graph layout.
set.seed(1)
layout <- create_layout(g, layout = "kk")

ggraph(layout) +
  # All edges: faint, no arrows.
  geom_edge_link(aes(edge_width = ew, edge_color = edge_type),
                 alpha = 0.35, lineend = "round") +
  # TF edges only: emphasized with arrows.
  geom_edge_link(aes(edge_width = ew, edge_color = edge_type,
                     filter = edge_type == "TF"),
                 arrow = arrow(length = unit(2.5, "mm"), type = "closed"),
                 end_cap = circle(2.5, "mm"),
                 alpha = 0.9, lineend = "round") +
  geom_node_point(aes(color = node_type, size = size)) +
  geom_node_text(aes(label = name), repel = TRUE, size = 3) +
  scale_color_manual(values = node_cols) +
  scale_edge_color_manual(values = edge_cols) +
  scale_edge_width(range = c(0.2, 2.0), guide = "none") +
  scale_size_identity() +  # Use actual size values from nodes
  theme_void() +
  ggtitle("AP1 & JUN directed regulatory module with STRING interactions among DEGs") +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5))

# KEGG pathway overlays

# Average log2 fold changes across diseases for KEGG pathway overlays.
# pathview may download KEGG pathway data if it is not already cached locally.
mean_genes <- ranked_log2_fold_changes %>%
  imap(~ tibble(gene = names(.x), value = .x, dataset = .y)) %>%
  bind_rows() %>%
  group_by(gene) %>%
  summarise(mean_log2FC = mean(value, na.rm = TRUE)) %>%
  arrange(desc(mean_log2FC))

genes <- mean_genes$mean_log2FC
names(genes) <- mean_genes$gene



library("pathview")
hsa04142 <- pathview(gene.data  = genes,
                     pathway.id = "hsa04142",
                     species    = "hsa", low="blue",high="red",
                     kegg.dir = "figures")
library("pathview")
hsa04145 <- pathview(gene.data  = genes,
                     pathway.id = "hsa04145",
                     species    = "hsa", low="blue",high="red",
                     kegg.dir = "figures")

pv <- pathview(
  gene.data  = genes,
  pathway.id = "hsa04145",
  species    = "hsa",
  low  = "blue",
  high = "red",
  kegg.native = FALSE,
  kegg.dir = "figures"
)
library(Rgraphviz)

svg("figures/pathway.svg", width = 12, height = 10)
Rgraphviz::renderGraph(pv$graph)
dev.off()
```
